Court No. - 79 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 23171 of 2024 Applicant :- Shweta Srivastava Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 6 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Kumar Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.On an oral request of learned counsel for the applicant, the opposite party nos.3 to 7 in the instant application who has wrongly been impleaded in the instant application as the summoning order has been passed only against the opposite party no.2.
Therefore, the names of opposite party nos.3 to 7 are deleted from the array of the parties.

2. Heard Sri Manoj Kumar Singh, Advocate holding brief of Sri Rajesh Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Uday Bhan, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant had filed a complaint case on 21.10.2021 and the summoning order was issued on 22.04.2022 against the opposite party No.2 for the offences under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act,

since,
thereafter, repeatedly summon was issued and opposite party no.2 was not appearing before the trial court despite repeated summons issued. In view of the aforesaid, learned counsel for the applicant has prayed for a direction for expeditious disposal of the aforesaid case so that effective measures can be taken by the trial court.

4. The aforesaid prayer has not been opposed by the learned A.G.A. and looking to the fact that despite repeated summons issued, opposite party no.2 did not appear before the trial court concerned till date.
5. In view thereof, this Court does not find any good reason to issue notice to opposite party no. 2 and keep the matter pending.

6. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, without adverting to the merits of the case, the instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of with a direction to the concerned trial court to proceed in the mater expeditiously in accordance with law and the police authorities are also directed to cooperate in the trial to carry out the mandate issued by the trial court.

The trial court shall make an endeavor to dispose of the instant case as expeditiously as possible preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, it there is no other legal impediment.
